name: WebWise
summary: A web development session at Williams School: students built websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
description: MFC members ran an interactive session at Williams School. Students built websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript and learned basic ways to protect a site from common online threats.

name: Arena.exe
summary: A gaming event on a game portal, with strategy and skill-based challenges.
description: Participants played through a game portal of strategy and skill-based games and competed for the top of the leaderboard.

name: Queue-rious Coders
summary: A coding event built around stack and queue data structures, open to every level.
description: A coding event for participants of all levels, with problems built around stack and queue data structures.

name: TechWars
summary: A campus-wide team game: solve coding questions to capture territory, win offline mini-games for power-ups.
description: Teams solve coding questions to conquer territories on a shared map and play offline mini-games that grant power-ups.

name: Code to Survive
summary: Three rounds that mix an escape room, a murder mystery and a criminal hunt, solved with code.
description: A three-round event that combines an escape room, a murder mystery and a criminal hunt. Participants write and read code to move from one round to the next.

name: CloudForage
summary: An offline AWS cloud computing session led by Mr. Balamurugan G.
description: An offline session on AWS cloud computing led by Mr. Balamurugan G, covering AWS fundamentals, cloud architecture and practices for building scalable, secure projects.

name: WebWhiz
summary: A hands-on HTML and CSS workshop where participants built their own portfolio websites.
description: A hands-on HTML and CSS workshop. Participants learned the essentials of web development by building their own portfolio websites.

name: InnovationX
summary: A 36-hour hackathon with the Advertisement and Marketing Club, ending in presentations from the top five teams.
description: A 36-hour hackathon run with the Advertisement and Marketing Club: ideation, mentorship sessions and project work, closing with presentations from the top five teams.

name: Cyber Security and Ethical Hacking
summary: A speaker session with Mrs. Pooja V Joshi from EC-Council on privacy and cybersecurity.
description: A speaker session with Mrs. Pooja V Joshi from EC-Council on privacy and cybersecurity.

name: CodeCraft
summary: A beginner workshop on JavaScript fundamentals and the Document Object Model.
description: A workshop for beginners on the fundamentals of JavaScript and the Document Object Model.

name: Scavenger of the Year
summary: A scavenger hunt of tasks and riddles against the clock, with side games that unlock powers.
description: Teams race against time through a list of tasks, objectives and riddles. Side games unlock powers that can swing the result.
